algorithm.classifier: multinomial logistic regression; L2; C=1; lbfgs; max_iter=2000
algorithm.feature_selection: training-only rank-binned normalized dispersion; 20 mean bins; top 2000; Ensembl-ID tie break
algorithm.normalization: per-cell library-size scaling to 10000 followed by log1p
algorithm.pca: training-only centered full SVD; at most 50 components
algorithm.prediction: held-donor fold only; softmax probabilities; no observed label
algorithm.split: SHA256(split_seed NUL donor_id), first 8 bytes big-endian modulo 5
algorithm.training_weights: equal class mass, then equal donor mass within class, rescaled to training cell count
